entries.1a226d95c0264cdb: This segment, operated by consolidated subsidiary AXYZ Foods Co., Ltd., runs franchise stores of Nippon Kentucky Fried Chicken Co., Ltd. (Kentucky Fried Chicken). Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥4,112 million, up 9.3% year on year.
entries.5c2b2fcf9b7821f7: This segment manufactures and sells chicken meat from broilers raised at company-operated fattening facilities, and processed foods such as karaage and chicken nuggets made from that chicken. In addition to achieving drug-free rearing, it also manufactures and sells Shirasu balloon and zeolite products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥24,674 million, up 11.2% year on year.
entries.66cbddd16c04e31a: A food company based in Kagoshima that handles, as a group and in an integrated manner, everything from feed manufacturing to chicken raising, chicken meat processing, processed foods and restaurants.
entries.d0384675e90f5455: This segment supplies renewable energy. Biomass energy made from chicken droppings is used at the company’s food plants and other facilities, and surplus electricity is sold to electric power companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥457 million, down 4.0% year on year.
entries.e075abbd39860fe1: The company is headquartered in Kagoshima City, Kagoshima Prefecture, and its main business is providing chicken meat needed in daily life to general consumers. The group consists of the company, seven consolidated subsidiaries (AXYZ Foods Co., Ltd., AXYZ Chemical Co., Ltd., Kinkowan Shiryo Co., Ltd., Minami Kyushu Chikusan Co., Ltd., Gumyo Farm Co., Ltd., IM Poultry Co., Ltd. and Jōyama Service Co., Ltd.) and one affiliate (Minami Kyushu Biomass Co., Ltd.). The number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was 1,290. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
